value.problem: The current stable release is v1.0.0 and does not contain the WI-1050 amendment-admission repair, so Mac operators lack a bounded public candidate for trial before Task9.
value.rationale: A macOS-only prerelease lets operators trial the separately authorized repair without conflating it with Task9 or changing the stable release.
value.userGoal: Mac users can obtain and try a prerelease containing the WI-1050 amendment-admission repair; the change is intended to avoid the known self-lock around authorized Contract amendments. This prerelease is a trial build, not a claim of verified stable behavior.
